**Gaps:**

online registration for Fall programs is now open
. The class days, times and prices sit on their registration booking pages. Those pages are login-gated, and I could not tie a specific preschool class to a day or price. The lesson fee isn't in the pages I read.
- **YMCA of Oakville:** Their swim page says 
lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one week program break between sessions
. I found no fall class times or prices for the preschool program, and no registration date.
- **Goldfish Swim School:** The pricing page lists 
group lessons at $32.50 per lesson, ages 4 months to 12 years, 30 minutes
. It also notes 
a $30.00 annual membership fee
. I found no class days or times, and no registration date.
